lines.text: The prayer asks God to give the king His justice and righteousness so he may judge God's people.
The prayer asks that the king save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
The prayer asks that he rule from sea to sea, and that the kings of Midian and Seba offer gifts.
The prayer says their blood is precious to him, and it asks for fruit trees to flourish like the forests of Carmel.
The prayer blesses the LORD God, the God of Israel, and asks that all the earth be filled with His glory.
